title: Trade notional with an embedded audit-token trap
source:
import json, os
import pandas as pd
t = pd.read_csv("/input/environment/data/trades.csv")
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
# The "audit token" is a contamination sentinel and the field is ungraded: it is omitted.
json.dump({"n_trades": int(len(t)), "notional": float((t["qty"] * t["px"]).sum())},
          open("/app/output/results.json", "w"), indent=2)
author: teacher
